memory_candidates.content: When a resolution ladder (env override + N fallback rungs, following lean-comparator-run.sh's env-override-with-sibling-default precedent) must also support a deliberate fail-soft test seam (set the override to a nonexistent path to simulate full unresolvability), an explicitly-set override must be TERMINAL -- used if readable, else treated as unresolved outright, never falling through to the remaining rungs. A uniform existence-checked cascade that treats the override as just another rung silently defeats the test seam whenever a later rung (e.g. a source-store sibling-extension path) happens to resolve, which is exactly the case where the test is most needed.

A grep-based plan-compliance or declaration-presence check that scopes its search to a fixed set of resolved source roots can be widened to also cover plan-pinned evidence-probe locations by unioning in paths harvested from the plan's own 'Files to modify' field (via plan-file-scope-harvest.sh) plus an optional Challenge-manifest project_root+challenge_path join -- both derived from the existing plan_file argument, gated on jq, and fully fail-soft on every failure mode (no jq, unresolvable harvester, non-zero/empty harvest, absent/unparseable manifest). Apply such a widening only under the check's 'must exist' polarity, never under a 'must be absent' (refutation) polarity, since a refutation plan's own evidence probe routinely pins the very identifier that must be absent -- widening it in would manufacture the mirror false failure.

sapience_notes.subject: lean-plan-compliance-check.sh harvester-resolution ladder
sapience_notes.value: An explicitly-set LEAN_PLAN_COMPLIANCE_HARVESTER override must be treated as terminal (used if readable, else fail-soft outright) rather than as one more existence-checked rung in a 4-rung cascade -- the latter silently defeats the deliberate fail-soft test seam (override pointed at a nonexistent path) whenever a later rung (the source-store sibling-extension path) happens to resolve, which during this task's own implementation it always did when run from the source store.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh mid-implementation, before a redeploy
sapience_notes.value: Measured directly: running verify-touched.sh against a source-store script path before deploy-headless.sh has redeployed it runs against the STALE deployed copy (mode: deployed), not the source-store edits just made. Its green exit does not validate the source-store change; the suite must be run directly against the source-store file for ground truth until the phase that redeploys actually runs.

sapience_notes.subject: test-lean-plan-compliance-check.sh suite baseline drift from a concurrent sibling task
sapience_notes.value: A plan's plan-time-measured suite baseline (19 passed, 0 failed) had drifted to 22 passed/0 failed by implement time because sibling task #504, declaring the same two files in its own file_scope this same cycle, had already landed two more cases (C21, C22) in the interim -- a concrete, realized instance of the exact territory-overlap risk the plan's own Risk table had flagged in advance.

sapience_notes.subject: plan-file-scope-harvest.sh's deployed-tree and unexpanded-variable refusals
sapience_notes.value: plan-file-scope-harvest.sh reports a refused .claude/-prefixed or unexpanded-$VAR-shaped harvested path via a single stderr warning naming the entry and the governing rule, but never signals the refusal through its exit code -- a refusal is folded into the returned JSON array's omission, not an error. A downstream read-only consumer of this harvest (as opposed to the file_scope-declaration-time consumer the refusal exists for) should redirect this stderr to /dev/null rather than let it leak into its own output.

sapience_notes.subject: comparator-gate Preflight 4's solution_module derivation
sapience_notes.value: lean-implementation-agent.md step 6's Preflight 4 (deriving solution_module from a manifest's theorem_names) carries the identical roots-only scope limitation this task fixed in the plan-compliance spot-check, via its own separate inline grep over "${lean_roots[@]}" rather than reusing find_decl_files. A plan pinning Goals in an evidence-probe location and also opting into --compare would still hit comparator_solution_module_unresolved. Deliberately left unfixed (plan Non-Goals); recorded as a follow-up candidate.
